entries.title: I Chronicles 18:1
segments: ¶Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

words.text: it came to pass, that David

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:2
segments: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, [and] brought gifts.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:3
segments: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates. {Hadarezer: or, Hadadezer}

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:4
segments: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot [horses], but reserved of them an hundred chariots. {seven...: or, seven hundred}

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:5
segments: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men. {Damascus: Heb. Darmesek}

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:6
segments: Then David put [garrisons] in Syriadamascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, [and] brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:7
segments: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:8
segments: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass. {Tibhath...: called in the book of Samuel Betah, and Berothai}

words.text: . {Tibhath...: called in the book of Samuel Betah, and Berothai}

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:9
segments: ¶Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah; {Tou: also called, Toi}

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:10
segments: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and [with him] all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass. {Hadoram: also called, Joram} {to enquire...: or, to salute} {to congratulate: Heb. to bless} {had war: Heb. was the man of wars}

words.text: ;) and [with him] all manner of vessels
. {Hadoram: also called, Joram} {to enquire...: or, to salute} {to congratulate: Heb. to bless} {had war: Heb. was the man of wars}

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:11
segments: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all [these] nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:12
segments: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand. {Abishai: Heb. Abshai}

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:13
segments: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:14
segments: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:15
segments: And Joab the son of Zeruiah [was] over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder. {recorder: or, remembrancer}

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:16
segments: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, [were] the priests; and Shavsha was scribe; {Abimelech: also called, Ahimelech} {Shavsha: also called Seraiah or Shisha}

words.text: ; {Abimelech: also called, Ahimelech} {Shavsha: also called Seraiah or Shisha}

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:17
segments: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada [was] over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David [were] chief about the king. {about...: Heb. at the hand of the king}

words.text: . {about...: Heb. at the hand of the king}
